_note: Curation gate for scripts/build-college-photos.py. Every entry was verified by a person (agent) on 2026-10-13: the Commons file was viewed at thumbnail size, its description page read, its license/creator confirmed through the Commons API, and the official source URL fetched to confirm the venue or recognition.
